_comment: Sedo ownership verification (TXT on the zone apex, host '@'), so the owner can list these domains for sale on sedo.com. The value is the owner's Sedo verification ID, public by design (anyone can read it in DNS). Source: owner's message of 11 Oct 2026 with the Sedo guide ('TXT, Response = verification ID, Host blank or @') and screenshots of the Sedo domain list; only the domains shown there are listed. dawa.es is not the owner's and must never be added. Applied by .github/workflows/dns-records.yml.
